items.title: Show HN: Roomantic – See if that piece furniture fits before buying it
items.contentSnippet:
Roomantic is a project I started working on earlier this year when I learned that iPhone Pro models have a LiDAR scanner and almost no practical apps that take advantage of it.
It uses Apple’s RoomPlan API to generate floor plans, and then allows you to paste in links to furniture and visualize if it would fit into your space.
Every feature is free, a subscription option exists if you want unlimited furniture placements (since those actually cost me money).

items.title: Show HN: Founder.best – A place for founders to keep their products discoverable
items.contentSnippet:
I built Founder.best to solve a problem I've experienced myself:
You launch a product, get a burst of attention, and a few days later it's buried somewhere on the internet.
Founder.best gives products a permanent public page where people can discover them after launch day.
I'm experimenting with product updates, recurring discovery, and SEO-focused product pages rather than making it just another collection of links.
It's still very early, so I'm mainly looking for feedback

items.title: Show HN: SiteTell: finds the areas of your site that read as AI-generic
items.contentSnippet: Hey everyone, I built this product called SiteTell. You put in your website url, it returns a list of all of the things across the site that get flagged as likely to be AI-written/AI-generic. It works against a curated rule set (which will obviously get updated as AI models update and evolve) and then you can fix these issues and get a PDF/CSV/JSON file that you can download to either take the suggested fixes yourself and apply them, or use the CSV/JSON file to drop into your agent for it to fix

items.title: Show HN: FFmpeg Commander – A command generator for common encoding workflows
items.contentSnippet:
I originally built this around 7 years ago in Vue2 and Bootstrap as a simple static frontend tool to generate common ffmpeg commands.
I recently ported it over to Vite/React/Tailwind via Claude (Opus 5) and thought it did a pretty good job. So figured I'd re-share it again as V2.
Quite impressed how fast AI was able to port this over. It made me think about revitalizing some old projects. :)

items.title: This founder is teaching chips how to recycle (their energy)
items.contentSnippet: Throughout the history of the computer chip, engineers have treated waste heat as an inevitable cost of a calculation. Hannah Earley, however, thinks it’s a design choice. Earley, 31, is cofounder and chief technology officer of Vaire Computing, a startup building chips that recycle energy usually thrown away as heat—a strategy known as reversible computing.…

items.title: When to Innovate, When to Implement, and When to Improve: A Framework for Strategic Schools
items.contentSnippet: Not every school challenge calls for the same solution, but most systems are only fluent in one approach. In this new piece, Nate McClennen and Rebecca Midles unpack the critical differences between implementation science, innovation, and improvement science, and show leaders how to build the organizational fluency to use all three.
